points.description: States that the neuron model has a set of synapses (connecting links), each characterized by its own weight (synaptic weight).
points.partial_credit: Half only if synapses/links are named but weights are not stated, or vice versa; actually 0 if either term is missing or wrong.

points.description: States an adder (linear combiner) that computes the weighted sum of the inputs (the local field / induced local field).
States that a bias is added to the weighted sum of the inputs.
States an activation function (squashing function) that limits the amplitude of the neuron's output.

rubric.notes: Full marks need all four elements stated explicitly with the correct terms: synapses with weights, adder/linear combiner (weighted sum), bias, and activation (squashing) function limiting output amplitude. Vague wording such as "inputs are multiplied and processed" earns nothing for that point. A wrong statement within a point (e.g. the activation function described as computing the sum) cancels that point.
